title: Verify chapter heading spacing in actual browser
body: The chapter heading fix adds a literal space character inside the span after chapterLabel. The original code used mr-2 (margin-right) which should create visual spacing, but the QA report said '2Chapter 2' with no space. The fix ensures a literal space is present. Verify in browser that the heading renders correctly with visible spacing.
rationale: CSS margin may not always create visible space in all rendering contexts. The literal space ensures proper separation.
